context_and_flow.screen_type: App onboarding screen showing a lifestyle image and value proposition text for a fitness tracker.
context_and_flow.ux_intent: Explain the value proposition of the WHOOP fitness tracking system to a new user.
ux_patterns: The hero image features a real-world photograph of an athlete, which reinforces the fitness-focused message.
The blue circular progress/data element provides visual interest and highlights the focus on metric tracking.
The typography is clean, sans-serif, and white, ensuring high readability against the dark background.
A bottom pagination indicator is present, suggesting this is one screen of several in a slider/carousel flow.

visual_keywords: Dark mode interface with a high-contrast, professional, and athletic photography aesthetic.
